title_sq: ISH FUSHA E AVIACIONIT, SHESIM APARTAMENT 2+1+2
description_sq:
Te Fusha e Aviacionit, shesim apartament 2+1+2 ne nje ndertim te ri ne faze ndertimi.
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e 4 banim te nje kompleksi shume te bukur dhe cilesor. Organizohet ne nje sallon ndenje se bashku me ambientin e gatimit, nje dhome gjumi matrimoniale me tualetin e dedikuar, nje dhome gjumi femijesh, nje tualet te pergjithshem dhe nje ballkon. 
Kompleksi eshte projektuar me standarte ndertimi te viteve te fundit, hapsira te perbashketa gjelberimi si dhe shume facilitete. 
Per me teper informacion ose nje vizite ne prone kontaktoni ne numrin e telefonit te poshte shenuar.
title_en: FORMER AVIATION FIELD, APARTMENT FOR SALE 2+1+2
description_en: In the Aviation Field, we sell a 2+1+2 apartment in a new building under construction. The apartment is located on the 4th residential floor of a very beautiful and quality complex. It is organized in a living room together with the cooking area, a matrimonial bedroom with a dedicated toilet, a children's bedroom, a general toilet and a balcony. The complex has been designed with construction standards of recent years, common green spaces and many facilities. For more information or a visit to the property, contact the phone number below.
